conclusions: Do not sum 2x100 pA and call it guaranteed worst-case leakage.
The 350 mV maximum at 5 V cannot directly certify the actual 3.3 V comparator output-low voltage.
Q4 normal-on DC calculation lacks a guaranteed total gate-node leakage bound. Fault-off calculation also requires the real output-low envelope and MOSFET off-current at that residual gate voltage.
No evidence here establishes hardware failure; it establishes missing specification coverage.
Next decision: compare a guard topology or comparator with published bounds covering actual supply, output load and temperature, while retaining the temperature protection function.
